skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — trim the intro, add text overlays, and download as MP4 — and get edited do...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Editor and Downloader.

- Instantly edit and download videos with natural language instructions (trim, overlays, export to MP4, and more)
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM uploads (up to 500MB)
- No local install or complex setup required; all processing done on cloud GPUs
- Quick turnaround (30–60 seconds for short clips), optimized for fast download
- Seamless onboarding with automatic API token/session management for all users
- Handles importing, live status, credits, and exporting via a streamlined workflow
